statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-92388: when an FTP wildcard transfer (CURLOPT_WILDCARDMATCH) fails during the LIST step, libcurl leaves its internal list parser installed as the handle's write callback, so reusing or duplicating that easy handle can crash, read freed memory, or write server data through the application's write data pointer (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-92388.html). It affects libcurl from 7.21.0 to 8.22.0 (not the curl tool) and was fixed in curl 8.23.0 by https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/ba8f8a7f27a5c5e19e4ef212b90b35a93559163e, which stops overwriting the application's write callback and adds Curl_ftp_listmode() to route listing data to the parser, and https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/b85acacec9b38442741bb019bc992e77b5f665d4, which limits that routing to the wildcard matching state. The DHI curl packages for Alpine 3.23 published in the DHI Alpine main repository as of 2026-11-28 are builds of curl 8.17.0-r1, 8.18.0-r0, 8.19.0-r0, 8.20.0-r0, 8.20.0-r1, 8.21.0-r0, 8.22.0-r0, 8.23.0-r0 and 8.23.0-r1, and the version string in each build's libcurl matches its package version. In the static libcurl.a in curl-static and in the libcurl debug symbols in curl-dbg, on x86_64 and aarch64, Curl_ftp_listmode is defined in 8.23.0-r0 and 8.23.0-r1 and in no earlier build; in those builds the client writer object built from cw-out.c refers to it, and its code compares the wildcard state for equality with the matching state, as the second commit requires, rather than less-or-equal. 8.23.0-r0 is the first fixed build. Packages published only in the DHI Alpine security repository, which needs credentials, were not inspected.
